steps.en: Install the CLI with the shell script, Homebrew cask, or the desktop app
steps.zh: 用安装脚本、Homebrew 或桌面应用装上它

steps.en: Start the local server (foreground) or the background daemon
steps.zh: 启动本地服务（前台）或后台守护进程

steps.en: Discovers every supported agent's session dirs and indexes the conversations into a local SQLite archive
steps.zh: 发现各 agent 的会话目录，把对话索引进本地 SQLite

steps.en: Serves the web UI on loopback with full-text search, analytics and cost dashboards
steps.zh: 在本机回环地址打开 Web UI：搜索、分析与成本看板

steps.en: Ask the shell for cross-agent token and cost reports any time
steps.zh: 随时在终端查跨 agent 的 token 与花费报表

value.en: Find what any agent did and what it cost, without sending your transcripts to anyone's cloud
value.zh: 不上传对话记录，就能查任何 agent 做过什么、花了多少钱

sources: README.md kenn-io/agentsview main @ 2026-09-28: Install section verbatim 'curl -fsSL https://agentsview.io/install.sh | bash' and 'brew install --cask agentsview'; Quick Start verbatim 'agentsview serve' / 'agentsview daemon start' / 'agentsview usage daily'; first-run paragraph: 'discovers sessions from every supported agent on your machine, syncs them into a local SQLite database, and serves a web UI at http://127.0.0.1:8080'; Privacy section: server binds 127.0.0.1 by default
